# netbox_ipsec_profile (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/vpn/ipsecprofile/):

> An IPsec profile combines an IKE policy and an IPsec policy for a tunnel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_ipsec_profile" "example" {
  name            = "example"
  mode            = "esp"
  ike_policy_id   = netbox_ike_policy.example.id
  ipsec_policy_id = netbox_ipsec_policy.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ike_policy_id` (Number) The ID of the ike policy associated with the ipsec profile.
- `ipsec_policy_id` (Number) The ID of the ipsec policy associated with the ipsec profile.
- `mode` (String) One of [esp, ah].
- `name` (String) The name of the ipsec profile.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the ipsec profile.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the ipsec profile.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the ipsec profile. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_ipsec_profile.example 1
```
